narrative.details: The Tauren, Kanati Greycloud is bold to set up a hunting camp in Thousand Needles. We must kill him to rid this hunting camp and all who may follow him. We will converge at the small post Southwest of the Great Lift.
narrative.objectives: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.
narrative.offerRewardText: They come to kill me? I will show them how a Tauren fights!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 28, 4,600 XP in all.
